display.label: Azure Container App
display.description: Azure Container App for running containerized microservices and web applications on a serverless platform

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Container App. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Container App identification and environment settings.

fields.label: Container App Name
fields.description: Specifies the name of the Container App. Must be 2-32 characters using lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens.

validation.pattern_error: Container App name must be between 2 and 32 characters, start and end with an alphanumeric character, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: Specifies the name of the Resource Group in which the Container App should exist.

fields.label: Container App Environment ID
fields.description: The resource ID of the Container App Managed Environment in which this app runs.

fields.label: Revision Mode
fields.description: The revisions operational mode for the Container App.

fields.label: Workload Profile Name
fields.description: The name of the Workload Profile where this Container App should be placed (e.g., Consumption or dedicated).

sections.label: Container Template & Scaling
sections.description: Configuration of container images, compute resources, replicas, and scaling behavior.

fields.label: Template Settings
fields.description: Template configuration block.

fields.label: Minimum Replicas
fields.description: The minimum number of replicas for this container app (set to 0 for scale to zero).

fields.label: Maximum Replicas
fields.description: The maximum number of replicas for this container app.

fields.label: Revision Suffix
fields.description: An optional suffix to append to the generated revision name.

fields.label: Containers
fields.description: List of container definitions for the container app revision.

fields.label: Container Name
fields.description: The name of the container.

fields.label: Container Image
fields.description: The container image repository and tag.

fields.label: CPU Cores
fields.description: The amount of vCPU allocated to the container (e.g. 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2).

fields.label: Memory
fields.description: The amount of memory allocated to the container (e.g. 0.5Gi, 1.0Gi, 2.0Gi).

fields.label: Entrypoint Command
fields.description: Command to run when starting the container.

fields.label: Command Arguments
fields.description: Arguments to pass to the container command.

fields.label: Environment Variables
fields.description: List of environment variables for the container.

fields.label: Variable Name
fields.description: The name of the environment variable.

fields.label: Variable Value
fields.description: The value of the environment variable.

fields.label: Secret Name Reference
fields.description: The name of a secret defined in the Container App to use as the value.

sections.label: Ingress & Traffic
sections.description: Configure HTTP/TCP ingress, external connectivity, and traffic routing.

fields.label: Ingress Configuration
fields.description: Ingress settings for receiving network traffic.

fields.label: Target Port
fields.description: The target port on the container where traffic is directed.

fields.label: External Access Enabled
fields.description: Whether ingress allows traffic from outside the Container App Environment.

fields.label: Transport
fields.description: Transport protocol for the ingress.

fields.label: Allow Insecure Connections
fields.description: Allow HTTP requests without automatic HTTPS redirection.

fields.label: Exposed Port
fields.description: The exposed port when transport is set to TCP.

sections.label: Managed Identity
sections.description: Assign System-Assigned or User-Assigned Managed Identities.

fields.label: Identity Configuration
fields.description: Managed Identity configuration block.

fields.label: Identity Type
fields.description: Type of managed identity to use.

fields.label: User Assigned Identity IDs
fields.description: List of user-assigned identity resource IDs.

sections.label: Secrets & Registries
sections.description: Configure app-level secrets and container registry authentication.

fields.label: Application Secrets
fields.description: List of secrets available to the Container App.

fields.label: Secret Name
fields.description: The name of the secret.

fields.label: Secret Value
fields.description: The sensitive value of the secret.

fields.label: Key Vault Identity
fields.description: User Assigned Identity ID used to fetch secret from Key Vault.

fields.label: Key Vault Secret ID
fields.description: Key Vault secret URL/ID.

fields.label: Container Registries
fields.description: Registry authentication settings for private images.

fields.label: Registry Server
fields.description: The login server for the registry (e.g. myacr.azurecr.io).

fields.label: Managed Identity ID
fields.description: Resource ID of the user-assigned identity to authenticate with ACR.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: Username for registry authentication.

fields.label: Password Secret Name
fields.description: The name of the secret containing the registry password.

fields.label: Dapr Settings
fields.description: Configure Dapr sidecar integration.

fields.label: Dapr App ID
fields.description: The unique Dapr application identifier.

fields.label: Dapr App Port
fields.description: The port your application is listening on for Dapr.

fields.label: Dapr App Protocol
fields.description: Protocol used for communicating with Dapr sidecar.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Key-value pairs to categorize and organize Container App resources.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: A mapping of tags to assign to the Container App resource.
